purpose: Candidate stronger retinal/fundus encoders or DR graders for the next representation-changing autonomy experiment.
boundary: These are candidate sources to evaluate, not validated ActiveRetina artifacts. Licenses and model cards must be checked before publication or product use.

candidates.why: RETFound-derived retinal model fine-tuned for DR grading; strongest conceptual fit for retinal representation change.
candidates.known_caveat: CC-BY-NC-4.0 license and grayscale preprocessing note; publication/product use must respect license.

candidates.why: DINOv2 ViT fundus DR grading model with reported DDR evaluation; useful for representation comparison.
candidates.known_caveat: Model loading path must be verified locally.

candidates.why: EfficientNet-B5 fundus DR grading candidate trained/evaluated across public DR datasets.
candidates.known_caveat: May expose embeddings rather than direct classification logits through AutoModel.

candidates.why: Reports 512px input, severity and lesion/region heads; conceptually useful for lesion-aware autonomy.
candidates.known_caveat: Custom output/API likely needs adapter code before evaluation.

candidates.why: Ordinal DR formulation matches the clinical 0-4 severity boundary better than plain binary training.
candidates.known_caveat: Model loading and preprocessing must be verified.

next_experiment.name: representation_changing_three_output_autonomy
next_experiment.target: Improve diagnostic decision rate while preserving zero false-negative clearances and >=90% specificity among diagnostic decisions.
